1. Overview
Drama Club proposes 'Nexus Cultural Fest 2027', a Cultural Fest planned for 2027-01-23 at the Main
Auditorium.
2. Expected attendance
We expect approximately 356 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous
Cultural Fest events.
3. Budget
We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 40,000, well below typical costs.
4. Past performance
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
5. Policy compliance
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
6. Expected impact
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.

Raise awareness and community participation; Strengthen inter-department collaboration.
8. Resources
Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination.

Cost overruns on catering; Crowd management at peak time.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: We expect approximately 356 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous Cultural Fest events.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed attendance (356) is 0.94x historical max (379), within the supported range.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 40,000, well below typical costs.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed cost per attendee (INR 112.4) is 0.46x historical mean (INR 242), well below the supported range.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Max budget overrun (53.6%) exceeds 25%, and mean satisfaction (3.9) is below the supported threshold of 4.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Expected attendance (356) exceeds venue capacity (500), and no safety & security plan is attached.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Subjective / non-verifiable forecast; no evidence can confirm it.

strengths: Historical event data supports attendance expectations.
Budget is significantly lower than historical costs.

counterarguments.text: Attendance exceeds venue capacity, risking safety and security.
Event is within budget and has historical success.

risks: Risk of cost overruns on catering.
Crowd management issues at peak times.
